all_conditions.comment: Conjunctive conditioning. If any of the conditions specified in this field aren’t met, there will be no roll for this act out.

any_conditions.comment: Disjunctive conditioning. If all of the conditions specified in this field aren’t met, there will be no roll for this act out.

m_ActorType.comment: if this act out is skill-related then this field only accepts PERORMER, TARGET, or SELF.

m_AdditionalSkillTags.comment: If m_Type is set to skill_aditional, this field is used to specify what skill to choose. If multiple tags are specified, it looks for a skill with any number of these tags. If multiple skills match this selector, only the first one is selected.

m_Chance.comment: Chance of triggering this act out if conditions are met.

m_IsZoomIn.comment: Only act outs that have m_Type set to skill_after, skill_block, or start_turn can use this field.

m_ActorControllerType.comment: RANDOM makes this actor to choose skills randomly. Move and wait actions count as skills too. This also supports INPUT which lets player to control what skill will be chosen.

m_ClearContainerTypes.comment: If another actor was transformed into this actor, buffs/DOTs/tokens will be removed. This is important, for example, for the final Confession boss that uses hidden tokens to track if a hero is still alive.

m_DeathChainIds.comment: If the actor referenced by this field dies, this actor dies too

m_EquippedCombatSkillLimit.comment: It can be increased, but values above 6 lead to UI overlaps, at least on my screen.

m_IgnoredSkillAttributeTypes.comment: Disallows this actor to gain buffs/quirks/tokens

m_IsBattleComplete.comment: If set to True, then fights will finish even if this actor is alive

m_QuirkContainerId.comment: A default roster_quirk_container can be swapped to make hero's starting quirks predefined.

m_ResistMaxOverrides.comment: Caps specified resistances so they can't go above the given value

m_ResistMinOverrides.comment: Caps specified resistances so they can't go below the given value

m_RosterOrderPriority.comment: Specifies hero's order priority at the Crossroads. PD's priority is 19, Abomination's priority is 5.

m_Tags.comment: brain_blessing tag indicates that this actor can become ordained in Act 1. Other blessings: lungs_blessing, eyes_blessing, arms_blessing, final_blessing

instance_buffs.comment: When an Infernal Flame or a trinket appears in game, it can acquire random buffs until the end of a run

launch_ranks.comment: Ranks on which this skill can be used. If the actor occupies several ranks, only the rank closest to the front counts.

m_AllConditionIds.comment: Conjunctive conditioning. If any of its conditions fail, this skill becomes unavailable.

m_AnyConditionIds.comment: Disjunctive conditioning. If all of its conditions fail, this skill becomes unavailable.

m_ConditionIdOverride.comment: Used in upgraded skills to make conditions insensitive to wether this skill is upgraded or not.

m_DeathClassTagIgnores.comment: If used, enemies killed by this skill will not leave corpses

m_IsRiposteDamaging.comment: Used in riposte skills. If set to True, this riposte skill is activated whenever its actor is damaged.

m_IsRiposteNonDamaging.comment: Used in riposte skills. If set to True, this riposte skill is activated whenever its actor targeted.

m_MatchingSkillIds.comment: Replaces this skill’s description in the Academic’s View

m_Chance.comment: Chance of this effect to be triggered when conditions are met. Default 1.

m_IsLockedTeamPosition.comment: Locks Token or Dot to the target rank.

m_IsVisible.comment: Is this effect visible in tooktips. Default True

m_Move.comment: Move target. Negative moves target forward. Positive moves target backward.

m_QuirkAddTag.comment: Add some amount of Quirks that have the specified tag.

m_QuirkRemoveTag.comment: Remove some amount of Quriks that have the specified tag.

m_ShowValue.comment: Specifies if the number of changed tokens should be displayed in tooltips.

m_SummonClassActorId.comment: Summon another actor to target team.

m_SummonLocationType.comment: Specifies on what rank the summoned actor should be placed.

m_TokenAddAmountRange.comment: Adds randomness to the number of added tokens. For example if `m_TokenAddAmount` is 1 and `m_TokenAddAmountRange` is 2, the number of added tokens will vary from 1 to 3.

m_TokenAddId.comment: Add some amount of the specified token.

m_TokenAddTag.comment: Add some amount of tokens that have the specified tag.

m_TokenConvertFromTokenIds.comment: Token conversion will target the specified tokens on target.

m_TokenConvertToId.comment: Tokens valid for conversion will be converted to the specified token.

m_TokenCopyAmount.comment: Number of tokens to copy from target to performer.

m_TokenCopyTags.comment: Copy some amount of tokens from target to performer. Tokens that have at least one of the specified tags will be copied.

m_TokenInvertAmount.comment: Number of tokens to invert. Pairs of inverse tokens are defined in Token elements.

m_TokenInvertIds.comment: Specifies what tokens will be inverted. Pairs of inverse tokens are defined in Token elements.

m_TokenRemoveId.comment: Remove some number of specified tokens.

m_TokenRemoveTag.comment: Remove some number of tokens that have the specified tag.

m_TokenStealTags.comment: Steal some amount of tokens from target to performer. Tokens that have at least one of the specified tags will be stolen.

stage_coach_armor.comment: Change stagecoach armor. Can be negative.

stage_coach_wheels.comment: Change stagecoach wheels. Can be negative.

leaning_affinity_tick_trigger_chance_mod.comment: Input is a sequence of values: m_MinValue, m_MaxValue, m_IsPositiveChange, m_ChanceModifier

stress_affinity_tick_trigger_chance_modi.comment: Input is a sequence of values: m_MinValue, m_MaxValue, m_IsPositiveChange, m_ChanceModifier

m_InvertTokenId.comment: Specifies an inverse token pair for this one. This information is used in effects that inverse tokens.

m_IsRankToken.comment: Adds a square bracket indicator under this token's icon, doesn't have gameplay effects

m_Limit.comment: Maximum number of tokens on an actor.

m_TeamLimit.comment: Maximum number of tokens on all team actors.

remove_any_conditions.comment: Removes this token when specified condition is met.

replace.comment: When this token is applied, it will replace specified token with another specified token.

cost.comment: Sets cost depending on unlock progress. Numbers are the decimal proportion of progress. Between these bounds the cost is set to the specified Cost.
